svg.text: Plain language becomes a structured spec, then a generated CrewAI project.
Templates own the shape. Four tiers own the verdict. The manifest owns the receipt.

g.text: Describe the work in plain language.
w2a convert, w2a validate, w2a demo: one terminal interface
plain-language Markdown in; interactive answers resolve
stdout, exit codes, and files are the only interface
Terminal transcripts are the capture surface.
LangGraph pipeline: parse, translate, lint, select, render,
Gemini or Groq returns agents, tasks, tools, edges, and
ambiguity gate records questions instead of inventing answers
A real model call, not a fixture.
deterministic selector: sequential, router, report, approval,
Jinja templates own the code shape; the model fills prose
closed tool registry: a real builtin or an explicit stub
A pass is a recorded verdict.
static: py_compile, ruff, AST import allowlist
env: fresh virtual environment, install, import
exec: mock-mode run plus task coverage; specificity: 0.60
The exec tier proves the crew runs, not that tools fire.
Fix the failure, not the story.
patch only the failing file, then revalidate
budget: three iterations, then an honest failure report
AST import-diff gate blocks a sneaked import on every repair
No infinite loop. No silent pass.
The receipt ships with the project.
manifest: spec, selected pattern, LLM calls, tool resolutions,
validation_report: tier results, repairs, specificity, verdict
committed transcripts and generated samples carry the claims
A stub is labeled a stub, never an integration.
Fresh ops workflow: 3 agents, 5 tasks, 7 files, pass, 0 repairs. Demo executed 5 sample tickets: 5/5 urgency decisions.
Manifest carries spec, pattern, LLM calls, tool resolutions, and file hashes. External tools stay labeled stubs.
No UI and no hosted endpoint. Terminal transcripts are real.
Generated samples are committed. A stub is not an integration.

svg.text: SOURCES: REPOSITORY + DOCS/DEMO TRANSCRIPTS 2026-07-18 + GENERATED SAMPLES + RESULTS.MD / NO INVENTED METRICS
